jobs.occupation: Digital Marketing Intern – B2B Food Supplements
jobs.description:
Who we areFermedics is a Ghent-based scale-up making fermented botanical ingredients for food supplement brands. And we’re growing fast: in recent years we’ve roughly doubled every year. We’re riding two big waves at once, a booming supplements market and the fermentation trend. Small team, big ambitions, short communication lines. 
Your missionHelp us build a real digital marketing strategy. The basics are already there: our website, LinkedIn, Semrush for SEO/GEO analysis, newsletters and Canva. Now we need someone to bring it all together, including a content plan for our newsletter, Instagram and LinkedIn communication. 
What you’ll be doing
 
 

• SEO & GEO: dig into Semrush, spot the gaps and fix them, so both Google and LLM models like Claude & ChatGPT find us 

• Sales funnel & Campaigns: map out our funnel and set up campaigns across channels and drive conversions 

• Website: improve findability, structure and conversion 

• Content: social posts, blog posts, mailings and website copy 

• Instagram: yes, B2B. Our customers (supplement brands) are there, so we should be too. You’ll launch and grow our account 

• Influencers: get relevant influencers on board to boost our reach and visibility 

• Showcasing finished products: plan how we highlight products made with our ingredients across the website, LinkedIn and Instagram 

• Visuals: create eye-catching marketing material 
 

• A student or recent graduate in (digital) marketing, communication or a related field 

• Digital native: you know social media, content and SEO, and you’re curious about AI search 

• Strong writer in English (Dutch is a plus) 

• Creative, hands-on and independent; you like to own your projects 

• Interested in health, food (supplements) or science? Then you’ll like it here!

Are you an experienced .NET DevOps Engineer with strong skills in ASP.NET Core and Azure DevOps pipelines ?

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET DevOps Engineer to join a dynamic platform team working in a large-scale Agile IT environment.

The team works transversally across the organization and focuses on making the Azure Cloud platform accessible, scalable and easy to use for other development teams. You will work in a multidisciplinary team following Agile, Scrum and SAFe methodologies.
Role
• Design, develop and maintain reusable .NET components using C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Design, develop and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD components using C#, PowerShell, YAML pipelines and Bicep.
• Collaborate with developers, testers, architects, Product Owners and Scrum Masters in a SAFe environment.
• Participate in PI Planning and other Agile ceremonies.
• Analyze and resolve technical issues and bugs.
• Perform code reviews and ensure high-quality code through unit and integration testing.
• Create and maintain technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing.
• Provide technical leadership, coaching and mentoring to less experienced colleagues.
• Continuously improve development processes, software quality and technical solutions.
• Stay up to date with relevant technologies and industry best practices.
Profile
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role.
• Strong experience with .NET, C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Solid experience with Azure DevOps and Azure Cloud.
• Experience with CI/CD, YAML pipelines, PowerShell and Bicep.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Strong technical coaching and mentoring abilities.
• Adaptability and a continuous learning mindset
 
Nice to Have
At least 1 year of experience with:

• WCF
• Blazor
• gRPC
• GitHub EnterpriseLanguages
• Dutch or French: Native level
• Second national language (Dutch or French): Basic written and spoken communication
• English: Good comprehension.

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

• 
Filing, grinding, and assembling components

• 
Cleaning and smoothing weld seams

• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings

• 
Delivering precise, high-quality work

Profile:

• 
You have experience as a welder or are a motivated school leaver

• 
You can read and understand technical plans

• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English

• 
You enjoy detailed, varied work during day shifts

We are looking for an experienced seamstress/seamster for a mattress manufacturing company in the Maldegem region!

What will your tasks be?

• You will be responsible for sewing covers and closing the mattresses.
As you gain more experience, we will teach you additional tasks step by step, such as:

• inserting zippers
• sewing on ribbons
• other finishing details

What do we expect from you? 

• You work accurately and contribute to a high-quality end product.
• You already have some experience with sewing or working on a sewing machine.
• You work precisely and are quality-oriented.
• You speak Dutch or English well!
• The job is mainly done standing up, so you must be physically able to do this.

For our client in the food industry, located in the Oudenaarde region, we are looking for an Order Picker who is willing to work in a 3-shift system.

Your responsibilities 

 
• You collect products from the cold and hot production lines and store them in the correct location in the refrigerator. 
 
• You label products correctly and register batch numbers, expiry dates and returnable packaging in MAPA. 
 
• You monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner. 
 
• You check incoming deliveries for quantity, temperature and condition, and register the information in MAPA. 
 
• You assist drivers with loading and unloading and correctly apply the FIFO principle. 
 
• You keep the warehouse, refrigerators and loading bays clean and tidy and ensure that returnable packaging is stored in the correct location. 
 
• You work an early, day or late shift – working hours vary depending on the schedule and the day. 

What are we looking for in an Order Picker?
 

 
• You have a good command of English. 
 
• You are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 7°C. 
 
• You can operate an electric pallet truck and a reach truck. 
 
• You are flexible and available to work early, day and late shifts, including occasional Saturdays or Sundays. 
 
• You work accurately: quantities, temperatures, batch numbers and expiry dates must be correct. 
 
• You are able to maintain an overview when several orders need to be prepared at the same time and can determine which tasks should be given priority.

Comecer is expanding its international Service Team! To strengthen our team in Belgium, we are looking for 
Field Service Engineers, preferably based in the 
Brussels–Leuven region. You will be employed by Orise NV 
(former Process Automation Solutions), based in Belgium, and part of ATS Corporation, while working closely with Comecer Netherlands BV and the wider Comecer team.
 

In this role, you will help install, maintain and support high-tech systems that play a critical role in the (radio)pharmaceutical and nuclear medicine sectors.
 

Comecer’s solutions are developed and manufactured in Joure (The Netherlands) and are used in complex laboratory environments worldwide.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you will be 
responsible for installing, servicing, and maintaining Comecer equipment at customer sites throughout Belgium. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring that each system performs optimally and meets all operational requirements. In addition, you will provide 
training and technical support to end users, helping them understand and operate the equipment effectively. Throughout every assignment, you will communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams, representing Comecer as a trusted, solution-oriented technical expert.

What you bring
 

You bring hands‑on experience in repairing technical equipment and troubleshooting both mechanical and electrical issues. You are able to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic and mechanical drawings, and you have a background in electronics, electromechanics or mechanical engineering. In this role, strong communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude are essential, along with a willingness to travel within Belgium and occasionally abroad. You have an energetic, proactive and solution‑driven mindset.
 

Requirements:
 
 

• Technical degree at secondary or bachelor level (electromechanics, electronics or mechatronics). 

• Strong English and French skills; Dutch is an advantage. 

• Experience with PLC-controlled systems is considered as a plus. 

• Valid category B driving licence.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service International - EN, IT, SPA, GER
jobs.description:
Are you customer-focused, organized, and eager to work in an international environment? In this temporary Customer Service role, you'll manage orders, coordinate with customers and logistics partners, and ensure an outstanding customer experience from start to finish.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a leading international organization operating within the pharmaceutical and health-related sector. Supporting customers across Western Europe, they are known for their commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. To strengthen their Customer Service team, they are looking for a temporary colleague who can help maintain their high service standards.

Omschrijving

• Manage customer orders from entry to delivery.
• Communicate with customers, warehouses, and sales teams.
• Handle returns, claims, and transport-related issues.
• Resolve customer inquiries and identify effective solutions.
• Maintain accurate documentation and ERP administration.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• 1-3 years of experience in customer service or administration.
• Familiarity with ERP systems, ideally Microsoft Dynamics or Axapta.
• Fluent in English; Spanish, Italian of German are a strong plus.
• Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to perform under pressure.

Our technological architecture must run alongside and support our business goals at Sopra Steria, and IT Architects make that happen by creating blueprints for software, hardware, networks, and data systems. Security and efficiency are safeguarded as IT Architects conduct risk assessments and ensure regulatory compliance. As an IT Architect, you’ll take the long view with a strategic planning mindset, deep technical knowledge, and strong problem-solving skills. Scalability as we work towards digital transformation is crucial, as we collaborate with stakeholders to adopt new technologies. 

Our Architects have the vision and leadership skills to make daring IT decisions that can make digital transformation a reality. Your ability to collaborate across teams and departments and your flexibility to adopt new technologies will help you enhance system performance, scalability, and security. Fulfil your software vision at Sopra Steria and align it with our business development goals. As a Sopra Steria Architect, you’ll have successful projects in your portfolio that can demonstrate your excellent problemsolving skills and commitment to continuous learning. 

 

Your profile

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! You have knowledge and experience of the following:

• Fullstack .NET development
• Git
• Docker
• Azure
• Kubernetes
• Event-driven
• N-tier
• Onion architecture
• Coaching people
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent 
• 
Languages: English and Dutch or French

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. Your impact as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

The Utilities market is in full transition. At Sopra Steria, we are enthusiastically participating in the digital acceleration within this sector through our Industry and Services market. We aim to grow our advisory agency for Utilities, helping our clients efficiently deal with both current and future challenges in energy transition and sustainable resource management by optimizing processes, improving asset utilization, and enhancing customer experiences.

Your role & responsibilities as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

As a Business Enterprise Architect, you will occupy a key position, crucial to growing our advisory agency within the utilities sector. You will play a significant role in expanding our Industry and Services market, and in executing our strategy to become the preferred digital business partner of our clients by 2026. Your role will be key in architecting digital solutions and strategies that put our clients at the forefront of the energy transition and smart utility management in a rapidly evolving market while driving the growth of our advisory services.

• Design and architect digital transformation initiatives for energy, water, and waste management utilities.
• Lead business framing and solution architecture for key digital themes such as (Transformation consulting, cybersecurity, Data & AI, applications & integrations, cloud & infrastructure).
• Develop enterprise architecture blueprints that align IT direction with business objectives.
• Actively contribute to growing our advisory agency by identifying new opportunities and expanding our client base in the utilities sector.
• 
Create and implement innovative architectural strategies to increase our market share in the Utilities sector, with a focus on digital transformation and sustainability.

 

Your profile as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

• Min 10 years’ experience of IT architecture experience, with 5+ years in digital transformation for the Utilities sector.
• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a plus.
• Proven track record in digital transformation initiatives, particularly in the energy sector and or water management projects.
• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and digital themes specific to utilities (e.g., Smart Grid, Energy Transition, Water Management Systems).
• Professional network in the Utilities sector.
• Excellent communication skills, able to articulate complex concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Strategic mindset with the ability to bridge business strategy and technical implementation.
• Passion for innovative technology solutions in utilities, especially in areas of sustainability and resource efficiency.
• Entrepreneurial spirit with a focus on growth and business development in the evolving utilities landscape.
As a member of one of Europe’s largest digital solutions providers, you’ll benefit from extensive career development opportunities, both local and international. At the Sopra Steria Academy, you’ll be part of a dynamic network of 56,000 professionals at all stages of their careers. With a wide array of offices to explore, you can find your ideal location and take the next step in your career. You’ll become a part of a major Tech player in Europe recognised for its consulting, digital services, and software development

As a data engineer, you will help our clients with building a variety of data applications in the cloud. Your role will involve working with the latest technologies to develop and manage data solutions tailored to their needs. Your responsibilities include the following: 

• Gather business requirements and translate them to technical specifications. 
• Design, implement and orchestrate scalable and efficient data pipelines to collect, process, and serve large datasets. 
• Apply DataOps best practices to automate testing, deployment and monitoring. 
• 
Continuously follow & learn the latest trends in the data world 

 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following: 

• At least 2 years of experience as a Data Engineer or in software engineering in a data context 
• Programming experience with one or more languages: Python, Scala, Java, C/C++, … 
• Knowledge of relational database technologies/concepts and SQL is required 
• Experience building, scheduling and maintaining data pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Data Factory, ...) 
• Practical experience with at least one cloud provider (GCP, AWS or Azure). Certifications from any of these is considered a plus 
• Knowledge of Git and CI/CD 
• Able to work independently, prioritize multiple stakeholders and tasks, and manage work time effectively 
• You have a degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology or related field 
• 
You are proficient in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus.

Mission of the role:
 

In this role, you will provide efficient support the Executive Director Innovation in the execution and achievement of his tasks primarily in area of agenda management and email communications.
 

The successful candidate will frequently interact with high level internal and external contacts and assistant the Executive Director in the daily management of the Innovation team.
 

Are you inspired by these responsibilities?
 

For the Executive Director, you will:
 
 
 
• Independently manage his agenda and efficiently co-ordinate the arrangement of meetings, travel, etc. 
 
• Sort emails, answers questions within the framework of certain instructions; transfer more complex issues to the appropriate persons in absence of the Executive Director 
 
• Organize and manage all logistical elements related to international/internal/external meetings, presentations, seminars, events, visits.... 
 
• Provide general administrative support within broad guidelines (e.g. making presentations, translating letters and documents). 
 
• Manage the Extranet/Website. 
 
• Perform basic accounting tasks of specific budgets 
 
• Provide support with HR-related issues including onboarding new team members. 
 
• Ensure the administrative interlink with the other  departments. 

Can you make the difference?
 

The successful candidate will be an experienced professional who demonstrates the following experience and competencies:
 
 
 
• A minimum of 5 years of work experience, preferably as an assistant at senior management level 
 
• Excellent written and oral communication skills 
 
• Proficiency in IT, web management and social media skills 
 
• Excellent level of English, written and spoken. Knowledge of other languages is an asset. 
 
• Full proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) 
 
• Excellent time management and organisational skills with the ability to prioritise work accordingly 
 
• Excellent interpersonal skills and customer orientation 
 
• Understanding of underlying issues and proactively developing and evaluating solutions

As a trilingual Administrative Assistant, you are the seamless link between teams, clients and leaders — elevating communication, efficiency and collaboration across every
 

Document & Information Management
 

Create, format and refine documents and timesheets with accuracy and attention to detail.
 

Update and maintain the contact database to ensure flawless information flow.
 

Edit and manage office floorplans when needed.
 

 
 

Meetings & Events Coordination
 

Organize meetings and conference calls, ensuring smooth logistics from start to finish.
 

Provide support for both internal and external events, contributing to their seamless execution.
 

Reception Support
 

Act as backup for reception:
 

Second floor: during lunch breaks, holidays and receptionist absences.
 

First floor: during client meetings.

You’re a sharp, fast‑moving administrative powerhouse who keeps everything — and everyone — on track. Fully fluent in English, French and Dutch, you switch between languages with ease, making communication smooth and effortless across the entire organization.
 

You love bringing order to chaos: calendars run better, documents look sharper, and operations flow smoother because you’re behind them. Detail‑driven but always thinking two steps ahead, you anticipate needs before they appear and handle challenges with confidence and positivity.
 

People count on you because you deliver — with efficiency, professionalism and a smile.
 

You’re proactive, reliable and naturally service‑minded, making you the go‑to person for both colleagues and clients. In short: you’re the kind of assistant who makes the whole office work better.

Primary responsibilities project management support (50%):
 
 
 
• Creating timelines and contributing to effective planning of funded project activities. 
 
• Monitoring budgets of EU-funded projects and tracking team members’ time dedication consistently, systematically, and coherently. 
 
• Supporting team members in completing tasks, drafting, and submitting reports. 
 
• Oversee and implement the communication and dissemination tasks of projects. 
 
• Support organising conferences, events, meetings, and other activities linked to projects. 
 
• Providing communication support to Processes4Planet projects. 
 
•   
 
• Communications activities and providing value to members (50%) 
 
• Create a yearly Communication Plan and track its implementation, 
 
• Manage and enhance the Association’s external communication channels (website, social media, newsletters, etc.),  
 
• Operate members-only collaboration tools (e.g. SharePoint), 
 
• Manage internal communication with company members by operating the existing tools or suggesting new ideas. 
 
• Generate and write content for social media, news releases, newsletters, bulletins, etc. 
 
• Prepare presentations and small publications and manage relations with providers. 
 
• Support to facilitate networking activities  
 
• Organise participation in external conferences, and support with organization of internal events (conferences, workshops, webinars, etc.). 

Qualifications and experience:
 

Degree in project management, communications, public relations, business administration or related studies.
 

Minimum 3 years of experience in positions dealing with the tasks described for this position, with excellent performance.
 

Experience with EU funds is an asset.
 

 Your key skills:
 

An energetic person with a hands-on approach, task-oriented with attention to detail
 

Team player with a cooperative spirit
 

Ability to work in a small core team and diverse virtual teams with people across organizational boundaries and several countries/regions.
 

Outstanding organisation and prioritization skills with a capacity to retro plan and fulfil strict deadlines.
 

High-quality results and output oriented.
 

Capacity to work with complexity and to juggle a variety of tasks flexibly and proactively.
 

Creative problem-solving skills, able to anticipate needs and deliver your work autonomously
 

 
 

Technical skills and languages:
 

Strong skills in Word, PowerPoint, Excel and collaborative online tools (e.g. SharePoint).
 

Experience in project management.
 

Excellent spoken and written English. Other languages are an asset.
